item.tib: spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma
item.skt: tsAr+ya saM gra ga pra dI paM
item.coloph: spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po paN+Di ta dI paM ka ra shrI dz+nyA na de nyid dang/ lo tsA ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus pa'o

item.tib: ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u
item.skt: sa mA dI sa g+ha ra pa ri barta
item.coloph: ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u /slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsA ba dge slong shAkya blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
